description: Baseline permissions for the passphrase entry and status popover windows — dialog access (confirm/file-pick, used from the Rust side, not these windows) plus the custom commands each window calls. "passphrase-*" (glob) because each concurrent prompt now gets its own uniquely-labeled window (passphrase.rs's PassphraseChannel keys by label, not a single shared slot) rather than a fixed "passphrase" label.
